updates.name: Hazel Levine
updates.bio: Research Assistant at the Connecticut National Estuarine Research Reserve. A marine scientist and educator trained in fisheries at the Universities of Massachusetts and Minnesota, she earlier taught marine science at Project Oceanology and worked part-time in a UConn lab examining links between phytoplankton and mercury.
updates.current_affiliation: Connecticut National Estuarine Research Reserve (NOAA, UConn and CT DEEP partnership)
updates.notes: Profile page on the CT NERR site (200) gives role and background; it uses 'She'. No ORCID found (pub.orcid.org expanded-search family-name Levine + given-names Hazel: 0 results). No Google Scholar link on the page.

updates.name: Jamie Vaudrey
updates.bio: Marine ecosystem ecologist and modeler focused on how people affect coastal waters. Trained in graduate school at UConn, she led UConn's part in creating the Connecticut NERR and is now its Research Coordinator, also advising Long Island Sound Study and Narragansett Bay Estuary Program science committees and community monitoring groups.
updates.research_interests: coastal ecosystem dynamics; effects of land use and human activity on coastal waters; eutrophication in Narragansett Bay, Long Island Sound and their embayments; nitrogen loading, trophic status and hypoxia modeling; seagrass (eelgrass) as a water-quality indicator, eelgrass genetics and restoration siting
updates.current_title: Research Coordinator, Connecticut NERR; Associate Research Professor, Department of Marine Sciences
updates.current_affiliation: Connecticut National Estuarine Research Reserve; Department of Marine Sciences, University of Connecticut
updates.notes: Bio from CT NERR profile (200; uses 'She'/'her'). Lab site vaudrey.lab.uconn.edu (200, linked from the CT NERR profile and the UConn Marine Sciences profile) lists 'Associate Research Professor, Dept. of Marine Sciences' and 'Research Coordinator, Connecticut National Estuarine Research Reserve'. ORCID 0000-0001-7338-8198 found via pub.orcid.org expanded-search; record name Jamie Vaudrey, employment Connecticut National Estuarine Research Reserve, Research Coordinator, 2022-present, and University of Connecticut Marine Sciences (consistent). No Google Scholar link on the CT NERR, Marine Sciences or lab pages.

updates.name: Jason Krumholz
updates.bio: Associate Professor at UConn serving as Stewardship Coordinator of the Connecticut NERR, where he supports resource inventory, conservation and restoration with federal, state and local partners. He trained at the Graduate School of Oceanography as an NSF IGERT fellow, then was the NOAA Northeast Fisheries Science Center's liaison ecologist for the Long Island Sound Study.
updates.current_affiliation: Connecticut National Estuarine Research Reserve (NOAA, UConn and CT DEEP partnership)
updates.notes: Profile URL slug is spelled 'jason-krumholtz' but the page is titled Jason Krumholz, Stewardship Coordinator (200; uses 'he'). ORCID 0009-0000-8183-3546 found via pub.orcid.org expanded-search (given Jason, family Krumholz); record name Jason Krumholz, employment University of Connecticut, Connecticut National Estuarine Research Reserve, Stewardship Coordinator, 2023-present (consistent). No Google Scholar link found.

updates.name: Josie Mottram
updates.bio: Research Assistant shared between the Connecticut NERR and UConn's Department of Marine Sciences, running nutrient analyses and studying nitrogen isotope biogeochemistry and how phytoplankton use nutrients. Her UConn oceanography master's thesis explored cold-water corals as a paleo-proxy for the marine nitrogen cycle.
updates.research_interests: nutrient analysis; nitrogen isotope biogeochemistry; phytoplankton nutrient utilization; cold-water corals as marine nitrogen-cycle paleo-proxies
updates.current_affiliation: Connecticut National Estuarine Research Reserve (NOAA, UConn and CT DEEP partnership)
updates.notes: CT NERR profile (200; uses 'Her'). An ORCID 0009-0003-3340-0289 exists for the name Josie Mottram (pub.orcid.org expanded-search), but the fetched record has no employment, education or biography, so it is not tied to this person and is not recorded. No Google Scholar link found.

updates.name: Katie Lund
updates.bio: Training and Engagement Coordinator at the Connecticut NERR since 2023, bringing reserve science to coastal decision makers through workshops and technical help led with partners. She spent over 20 years on coastal management at the Northeast Regional Ocean Council and Massachusetts Office of Coastal Management and earned an Oregon State MS in marine resource management.
updates.current_affiliation: Connecticut National Estuarine Research Reserve (NOAA, UConn and CT DEEP partnership)
updates.notes: CT NERR profile (200; uses 'she'). Profile also mentions a prior UConn climate institute post and a University of Michigan sustainability institute. No ORCID found (expanded-search Lund + Katie / Katherine with Connecticut: 0 results). No Google Scholar link.
updates.evidence: Katie Lund Training and Engagement Coordinator

updates.name: Kevin O'Brien
updates.bio: Reserve Manager of the Connecticut NERR, which he joined in 2023 after supervisory work at the Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection. There he worked on seafloor mapping and the Long Island Sound Blue Plan and was state lead in NOAA's designation of the reserve. He has a University of Miami graduate degree in marine affairs and policy.
updates.current_affiliation: Connecticut National Estuarine Research Reserve (NOAA, UConn and CT DEEP partnership)
updates.notes: CT NERR profile (200; uses 'he'). No ORCID found (expanded-search O'Brien + Kevin + Connecticut: 0 results). No Google Scholar link.

updates.name: Larissa Graham
updates.bio: Education Coordinator at the Connecticut NERR with nearly 15 years of bringing science to coastal audiences. She coordinated Long Island Sound Study outreach for New York Sea Grant, then worked on the Gulf Coast for the Grand Bay NERR, Mississippi-Alabama Sea Grant and the Student Conservation Association, where as Alabama and Mississippi State Director she guided young restoration crews.
updates.current_affiliation: Connecticut National Estuarine Research Reserve (NOAA, UConn and CT DEEP partnership)
updates.notes: CT NERR profile (200; uses 'she'). No ORCID found (expanded-search Graham + Larissa: 0 results). No Google Scholar link.

updates.name: Lauren Barrett
updates.bio: Associate Research Scientist at the Connecticut NERR and a marine biogeochemist. Her 2024 UConn Marine Sciences PhD examined how human pollution alters carbon dioxide chemistry in both the Arctic Ocean and Long Island Sound; she then served as a 2024 NOAA Knauss Fellow with the Democratic side of the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology.
updates.research_interests: marine biogeochemistry; interactions between people and marine environments; pollution effects on seawater carbon dioxide chemistry (Long Island Sound, Arctic Ocean)
updates.current_affiliation: Connecticut National Estuarine Research Reserve (NOAA, UConn and CT DEEP partnership)
updates.notes: CT NERR profile (200; uses 'she'). updates.name: Sam Stadnick
updates.bio: Fiscal Officer of the Connecticut NERR. He came to the reserve from the Connecticut House of Representatives, where he helped legislators with constituent services and legislative duties, and is a UConn political science graduate.
updates.current_affiliation: Connecticut National Estuarine Research Reserve (NOAA, UConn and CT DEEP partnership)
updates.notes: CT NERR profile (200; uses 'He'). Administrative role; no research focus stated. No ORCID found for this person (expanded-search family-name Stadnick: no Sam/Samuel). No Google Scholar link.

updates.name: Shelby Larubina
updates.bio: Research Technician at the Connecticut NERR and a UConn marine science graduate with an ecology and evolutionary biology minor. As a student she worked on nutrient pollution in local estuaries and on marine biogeochemistry and coastal ecosystem dynamics; since graduating she has continued in the Vaudrey and Tobias labs, working in Long Island Sound embayments, marshes and eelgrass beds.
updates.research_interests: nutrient pollution in estuaries; marine biogeochemistry; coastal ecosystem dynamics in Long Island Sound embayments, marshes and eelgrass beds
updates.current_affiliation: Connecticut National Estuarine Research Reserve (NOAA, UConn and CT DEEP partnership)
updates.notes: CT NERR profile (200; uses 'she'). vaudrey.lab.uconn.edu/people/ (200) lists 'Shelby Larubina, B.A.; 2022-2024' among research technicians and 2022 among undergraduate technicians (consistent). No ORCID found (expanded-search family-name Larubina: 0). No Google Scholar link.

updates.name: Ned H. Euliss Jr.
updates.bio: Research wildlife biologist with the U.S. Geological Survey, according to a USGS item dated March 14, 2016, which reported a recent Interior Department Meritorious Service Award (the department's second-highest honor for career staff) recognizing contributions to ecological science.

It calls him a research wildlife biologist for USGS; the NPWRC link comes only from the page's keyword tag, so the bio is date-bound to 2016. No USGS staff profile found. The lake's existing status 'emeritus' has no source found this run; not re-written. No ORCID for Euliss in pub.orcid.org expanded-search (only an unrelated Chandler Euliss).
